_comment: Job sources. Everything here is free. Keys marked (optional) need a free API key stored as a GitHub secret - see README.

jooble._comment: Keys live in keys.json (one per country site). Countries without a key fall back to the global jooble.org key, limited to global_key_countries.

gulftalent._comment: Best effort HTML. Blocked from some datacenter IPs (403); skipped automatically when blocked.

linkedin_guest._comment: LinkedIn public listings, all countries. pages x queries x countries requests; polite delay. Skips the rest of a country on a challenge.

workday._comment: Employer career sites on Workday. tenant / host / site verified from the employer's careers URL: https://<tenant>.<host>.myworkdayjobs.com/<site>

successfactors._comment: SAP SuccessFactors career sites (search page HTML). base = site root, slug = path segment.

workable._comment: Workable accounts (apply.workable.com/<account>). Rate-limited; the agent backs off.

seek._comment: SEEK Australia public search API (no key). Listing gives title/teaser/bullets/location/salary; job pages are blocked so scoring uses the listing text.

rigzone._comment: Rigzone - the main oil & gas job board. Free, no key. pages x queries x countries requests.

newspapers._comment: Sites that republish the Gulf newspapers' recruitment pages (Assignments Abroad Times, Gulf Job Paper ...). WordPress search API, no key. Country is guessed from the ad text.
